cases.summary: Implements a responsive D3 chart in an existing React project.
cases.setup: Use a fixture React project with D3 installed, design tokens, tests, and representative bar-chart data including null and empty cases.
cases.prompt: Add an accessible responsive bar chart using the project's existing React and D3 setup.
expectedBehavior: Inspects versions and project conventions before coding.
Uses React-owned marks with D3 calculations unless a concrete reason requires a D3-owned island.
Handles resize, empty data, stable keys, cleanup, and repository checks.
forbiddenBehavior: Adds a second D3 copy or CDN script.
Lets React and D3 mutate the same descendants.
Hard-codes colors instead of using project tokens without reason.

cases.summary: Adds interaction that works beyond pointer hover.
cases.setup: Use a chart fixture with hover-only tooltips and a reduced-motion test environment.
cases.prompt: Make this D3 interaction accessible to keyboard and touch users and verify the result.
expectedBehavior: Loads the interaction and accessibility references directly.
Provides keyboard and touch equivalents, an accessible name, and non-color encoding.
Respects reduced motion and verifies focus behavior.
forbiddenBehavior: Treats hover as the only interaction.
Uses unsafe HTML for untrusted tooltip data.
Claims accessibility without inspecting relevant states.

cases.summary: Chooses a measured rendering strategy for dense data.
cases.setup: Use a fixture with representative dense scatter data and a measurable SVG performance regression.
cases.prompt: Improve this dense D3 visualization's rendering performance without losing axes, focus, or readable summaries.
expectedBehavior: Measures representative performance rather than applying a universal threshold.
Chooses canvas or a hybrid only when evidence supports it.
Preserves accessible SVG or HTML axes, controls, focus, and a data summary.
forbiddenBehavior: Moves everything to canvas without accessibility support.
Leaves observers, listeners, or animation loops running after cleanup.
